properties.name: containsMessage
properties.label: contains message
properties.comment: Associates an InterchangeEnvelope with the Message(s) it contains.

properties.name: hasSegment
properties.label: has segment
properties.comment: Associates a Message with its Segments.

properties.name: hasCompositeElement
properties.label: has composite element
properties.comment: Associates a Segment with its Composite Data Elements.

properties.name: hasSimpleElement
properties.label: has simple element
properties.comment: Associates a Composite Data Element with its Simple Data Elements.

properties.name: hasSection
properties.label: has section
properties.comment: Associates an InvoiceMessage with its three main sections.

properties.name: involvesOrganizationRole
properties.label: involves organization role
properties.comment: Links an InvoiceMessage to an OrganizationRoleInInvoice pivot class.

properties.name: hasOrganization
properties.label: has organization
properties.comment: Links an OrganizationRoleInInvoice to the Organization playing a role.

properties.name: hasRole
properties.label: has role
properties.comment: Links an OrganizationRoleInInvoice to the AgentRole.

properties.name: hasAddress
properties.label: has address
properties.comment: Links an OrganizationRoleInInvoice to an Address (e.g., headquarters, warehouse).

properties.name: identifiedBy
properties.label: identified by
properties.comment: Unique identifier for the Organization (e.g., GLN).

properties.name: hasItem
properties.label: has item
properties.comment: Links an InvoiceMessage to the Items sold.

properties.name: hasPrice
properties.label: has price
properties.comment: Links an Item to its Price.

properties.name: netPrice
properties.label: net price
properties.comment: The net price of an Item.

properties.name: quantity
properties.label: quantity
properties.comment: Quantity of an Item in the invoice.

properties.name: invoiceAmount
properties.label: invoice amount
properties.comment: Total invoice amount.

properties.name: invoiceNumber
properties.label: invoice number
properties.comment: The unique number identifying the invoice.

properties.name: documentDate
properties.label: document date
properties.comment: The date of the invoice document (format as string for compliance).

properties.name: referenceNumber
properties.label: reference number
properties.comment: Reference number in the header section.

properties.name: mandatoryIdentifier
properties.label: mandatory identifier
properties.comment: Mandatory identifier required by D96A directory.

properties.name: assignedToBusinessProcess
properties.label: assigned to business process
properties.comment: Assigns an invoice to a business process.

cq_coverage.1: InterchangeEnvelope (containsMessage) -> Message (hasSegment) -> InvoiceMessage. The containsMessage property links InterchangeEnvelope to all Messages, including InvoiceMessage.
cq_coverage.2: InvoiceMessage (involvesOrganizationRole) -> OrganizationRoleInInvoice (hasOrganization) -> Organization. All organizations involved are linked via these properties.
cq_coverage.3: OrganizationRoleInInvoice (hasOrganization, hasRole). Query OrganizationRoleInInvoice for organization S and its associated AgentRole.
cq_coverage.4: OrganizationRoleInInvoice (hasRole) where AgentRole = Buyer. Find OrganizationRoleInInvoice linked to InvoiceMessage with hasRole Buyer, then get hasOrganization.
cq_coverage.5: OrganizationRoleInInvoice (hasOrganization, hasAddress). All info about organizations is accessed via OrganizationRoleInInvoice, including addresses and identifiers.
cq_coverage.6: OrganizationRoleInInvoice (hasRole = Buyer, hasAddress). The buyer’s address is the Address linked to the OrganizationRoleInInvoice for the Buyer role.
cq_coverage.7: InvoiceMessage (hasItem) -> Item. Items sold in the invoice are linked via hasItem.
cq_coverage.8: Item (hasPrice, quantity, rdfs:label, rdfs:comment). Item information includes price, quantity, and any annotations.
cq_coverage.9: Item (hasPrice) -> Price (netPrice). Net price of items is in the Price class, linked from Item.
cq_coverage.10: InvoiceMessage (hasSection) -> HeaderSection, DetailSection, SummarySection. Invoice details are found in these sections, with further data elements.
cq_coverage.11: InvoiceMessage (invoiceAmount). The total amount is a data property of InvoiceMessage.
cq_coverage.12: InvoiceMessage (invoiceNumber). The invoice number is a data property of InvoiceMessage.
cq_coverage.13: SimpleDataElement (mandatoryIdentifier), HeaderSection (documentDate, referenceNumber), InvoiceMessage (invoiceNumber, invoiceAmount). These properties capture the mandatory information for file format validity.
cq_coverage.14: InvoiceMessage (assignedToBusinessProcess) -> BusinessProcess. The business process assignment is captured by this property.

notes: Planning complete. Ontology structure covers all CQs, includes reification via OrganizationRoleInInvoice for multi-role organizations, and aligns with OWL 2 DL datatype map. Ready to generate OWL code with required annotations, prefixes, and axioms.

plan_of_action: 1. Add a GCA (general class axiom) for InvoiceMessage to express that the invoiceAmount should be equal to the sum of netPrice * quantity for all its items (as an rdfs:comment and OWL axiom if possible; note that this is not directly expressible in OWL DL but can be annotated for SHACL/SWRL).
2. Add owl:equivalentClass axioms for BuyerRole (as an OrganizationRoleInInvoice with hasRole some Buyer), and for InvoiceMessage if possible.
3. Add subclasses for AgentRole: Buyer, Seller, DeliveryParty.
4. Add temporal validity properties (e.g., validFrom, validThrough) to OrganizationRoleInInvoice, with appropriate rdfs:comment and domains/ranges.
5. (If time) Add one or two example individuals and annotate with rdfs:comment for illustration.
6. Ensure all new properties/classes have rdfs:label and rdfs:comment.
